messages:
alex_sales: EdgeWave RFP in — they want a single capability matrix + PoC plan + security answers. Deadline next Fri EOD. PDF link here: https://edgewave.example/rfp.pdf. Need short commercial bullets (pricing bands, PoC credit) and KMS/HSM wording. cc @maria_solution_eng @ben_platform @liz_legal

maria_solution_eng: Ok. Propose 1-5 scoring with a note column. I can take perf validation and a short acceptance test plan.

ben_platform: I'll draft an ops snippet and recommended infra. PoC duration: 3 weeks (infra + perf + acceptance). Recommend 4xA100-80GB equiv dedicated nodes.

liz_legal: Confirm NDA before sharing runbooks. For HSM line, we can state: "on-prem HSM option available with enterprise license; integration via PKCS#11/KMIP and field eng support". Also we prefer not to commit SLA for customer HSM hardware.

alex_sales: Draft capability CSV below — please adjust scores/notes. I'll include pricing: Hosted $0.0009/token gen, Dedicated committed + overage, Private license+support. Offer 10% PoC credit for 3-week trial.

```csv
feature,score,notes
model_catalog,5,"curated models, verified perf profiles"
streaming,5,"chunked streaming + SDK support"
private_deploy,5,"VPC & on-prem; KMS integrations"
batching_controls,4,"auto + manual controls"
quant_profiles,4,"A100 q8 validated; H100 testing"
```

maria_solution_eng: For quant_profiles I will attach short perf table for A100 numbers tomorrow AM. Also adding acceptance checks: throughput >=2000 tok/s sustained, 99p <300ms.

ben_platform: Ops snippet for their infra team — they asked for example deployment config:```
poс_environment:
  type: dedicated
  nodes: 4
  gpu: a100-80gb
  autoscale: false
  image: redwood-runtime:2026-02
  networking:
    peering: true
    allowed_cidrs: ["10.10.0.0/16"]
```

alex_sales: @liz_legal can you sign off on the HSM sentence so I can include in bundle? Also need boolean on whether we can share internal runbook (we need NDA).

liz_legal: Sign-off: the HSM sentence above is approved. Add: "requires separate SOW and engineering time for on-prem HSM integrations." NDA required for runbooks.

ops-bot: Created draft bundle at https://redwood.internal/sales/edgewave-draft (attachments: edgewave_matrix.csv, poс_infra.yaml)

maria_solution_eng: I'll populate perf numbers and a short test plan. ben, will you own deployment during PoC?

ben_platform: Yes, I'll be primary for infra and monitoring; maria owns validation and acceptance tests. alex will run commercial/NDA.

alex_sales: Plan: maria fills perf, ben finalizes infra snippet, liz finalizes legal wording, I assemble and send bundle by EOD Fri. Thanks all :pray:
